verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen streaming and remote-control app. User-defined automation rules are a plausible feature for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows fixed built-in automatic behaviors: the session moving to the home network by itself, a daily update check, and USB auto-pairing. Nothing shows a way for users to define event-triggered rules or actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
